metadata.title: Data Density Pass 11 -- Artillery Placement Detail, Both Armies
metadata.description: Individual battery placements for the most significant artillery positions across all three days. Buford's horse artillery, Pegram on Herr Ridge, Oak Hill Confederate batteries, Benner's Hill disaster, McGilvery's Plum Run Line, Osborn's Cemetery Hill guns, Alexander's cannonade line. Complements the brigade-level artillery already in base placement files.
